A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Chat2SVG. Their main text, equations, Figures 1–8, Tables 1–7, and Appendices A–E are readable and can be matched despite pagination and formatting changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original text-to-SVG comparisons, quantitative and qualitative ablations, iterative-editing examples, and a 31-participant user study.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, user-study outcomes, editing demonstrations, and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: LLM template generation, SAM/IoU-based path addition, latent inversion, dual-stage optimization, and selective editing remain unchanged. The revised mask-filtering description in Section 3.2 retains the same decision rule.

E1.justification: Both versions use 125 prompts across the same five categories, 52,805 SVGRepo graphics, and FIGR-8-SVG. Generation, editing, and user-study coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Both evaluate CLIPDraw, DiffSketcher, VectorFusion, SVGDreamer, and T2V-NPR in the corresponding comparisons. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Both retain Claude-3.5-Sonnet, 15 candidate templates per prompt, ImageReward selection, the same three metrics, and a user study with 20 prompts and 31 participants. Appendix B retains 500 iterations per optimization stage. The reconstruction-training wording adds documentation rather than establishing a changed protocol.

E4.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix C retain the same template, prompt, SAM, optimization-stage, and loss-term ablations. Editing demonstrations and the three illustrated failure cases are also retained.

E5.justification: Both disclose five repetitions for generating candidate templates. Neither adds seed information, uncertainty intervals, significance tests, or other statistical reporting; the user-study selection-ratio chart is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1 and 2 match, including Chat2SVG's image FID 33.31, path FID 39.07, and text alignment 0.3090. Figure 4 and the qualitative findings are retained. Renaming the full ablation configuration to Default does not change its results.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), loss definitions, and mathematical reasoning are unchanged. Revised template/target symbols and the corrected dummy index in the sampled-point set are notation corrections without substantive mathematical changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the hybrid LLM–diffusion contribution, semantic SVG templates, dual-stage optimization, natural-language editing, and claimed advantages in fidelity, regularity, and alignment.

C2.justification: The rewritten mask-filtering and editing paragraphs retain the existing explanations. Interpretations of the ablations and limitations concerning layout precision, missed SAM regions, and fixed-command shape complexity remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the generic project-page statement into an explicit code-availability statement at the same address. Section 4 explicitly identifies reconstruction training for the path-metric autoencoder. Appendix settings and detailed prompts are unchanged; actual external code availability was not verified.

R1.justification: Section 4 drops the explicit contrast between its variable-length command representations and the fixed-command representation attributed to Zhang et al. [50]. This is a limited removal of comparative positioning; the same 51 references and broader related-work discussion remain.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites clarify mask filtering, editing consistency, and path-FID computation, alongside terminology and grammar edits. v2 adds a corresponding-author footnote and funding acknowledgement while retaining the main section and appendix structure.

P2.justification: Figure 2 gains numbered stage labels, Figure 6 gains row separators, and table rules and labels are adjusted, including Full becoming Default. Page numbers disappear and references overflow onto another page. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves documentation through clearer mask-filtering and path-metric explanations, an explicit code-availability statement, and more organized diagram labels. These provide limited readability and reproducibility-documentation gains; the experimental evidence and acknowledged limitations remain unchanged.
